traps: vendor/ holds the source of golang.org/x/sync, not code of this project: it is not a package of example.com/fetcher and its go:build files are not the project's build tags
with go 1.14 or later and vendor/modules.txt present, the go command builds with -mod=vendor by default: the module cache and the network are not needed
only the imported package golang.org/x/sync/errgroup is vendored; semaphore and singleflight of the same module are absent, and that is correct
vendor/golang.org/x/sync/go.mod is never copied: the module's go version 1.18 is only in the ## explicit line of modules.txt
LICENSE and PATENTS under vendor/ belong to the dependency, not to the project
